verdicts.reason: A keeps the three price cards the same size with the dark Yearly card still featured. However, the subtitle is squeezed into a narrow left column that breaks after almost every word, the legal text is too small to read, and the CTA floats above dead space with nothing lining it up to the headline. B has the same wrapped subtitle, now so large it competes with the headline, and its Yearly card has shrunk smaller than Monthly and Family with tiny '48' text. That reverses the original's hierarchy, where Yearly was the featured plan, and makes the card row uneven and broken.
